title: Unit Event — On This Blank Canvas, I Paint — Episode6 The Stopped Brush

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint
meta.Event Outline: As N25's music evolves, Ena struggles to capture the true essence of their songs in her art. In the interest of keeping up with the group, she considers going back to her old art class...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Ena.
How was art class? I know it's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Same old, same old.
I'll be in my room until dinner...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I said I'd be going to that art class again starting today, so maybe I should let everyone in N25 know...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if any of them ask, “How was it?”)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <I've had a long day, so I'm gonna work offline for now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<Copy that!
Don't work too hard, alright?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line:
<Please rest when you feel better.
You don't have to worry about us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I still have that rough draft to finish.
I haven't even touched it for a few days now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But...
What am I supposed to draw...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But there's no point in worrying.
I have to just keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Day two is oil painting...
I used to get praised for the way I chose colors when I was in junior high...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Good morning, Ena.
You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
It looks like we're doing landscapes.
Let's do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Your underpainting needs more work.
It looks very uneven right now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(That's it for my drawing...
But this doesn't look right at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The worst part is that I can't specifically say what's wrong. Is it the underpainting? The perspective?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I sort of want to scrap it and start all over now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, she's already doing touch-ups...
Her painting has so much presence to it...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
That will be all for today.
Good work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Day two and still no results.
Mr. Yukihira gave me his usual criticism too.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I knew going into this that I can't make up for two years of not drawing seriously in just a few days...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry, I'm pretty exhausted...
I'm gonna head home. Bye bye.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm home...
Oh, right. Mom's out today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like having some tea...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Hm? Is someone home...?
Mom's said she'd be gone so... Akito?)

Ena...
I didn't realize you were home.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: More importantly, how's your class going...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, why do you know about...?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Draw anything that satisfies you yet?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I don't have a choice, do I...?
Also, there's only one day left so...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I'm not talking about the spring workshop. I'm saying that you'll keep feeling this pain if you choose to continue drawing...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You won't always be able to produce works that satisfy you. Can you deal with that pain moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Can I deal with that pain...?
How am I supposed to know...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, I clearly don't belong in that class and felt completely embarrassed after getting lambasted in front of everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I've only gone two days...
And I already feel like puking...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to run away anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which means... I have to keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What did you think of this demo...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It was light and uplifting...
I'm looking forward to seeing Mafuyu's lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, didn't you say that you haven't uploaded your last song yet because the video's missing the illustrations it needs?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's why we decided to go forward with me making some new demos. This is one of those.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But is Ena going to be okay?
She hasn't worked on her illustration in quite some time, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's true, but we know she's doing her best to produce the right art for us. So for now, let's give her a little more time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I sent her a message yesterday but haven't gotten a reply yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's probably still not happy with what she's drawn.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I hope it's not more than that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We talked before she went off to that art class, but she seemed really unsure about going. That kinda made me worried...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not sure if it's okay for me to say this right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I want to help Ena somehow if she is suffering because of all this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mind telling us more about what you two talked about, Mizuki?
